summary: Iteration 6: Verified 7 new attendance types (datang, pulang, dhuha, dzuhur, pramuka, tartil, ekstra_tahfidz) across backend + frontend. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass (kiosk/classes public, scan for all 7 types, invalid type -> 400, not_found, late logic gated to 'datang' only, /attendance list & recap accept all 7, dashboard admin present_today counts type='datang' post-migration, admin/guru/siswa logins). Frontend: Halaman Utama /login shows LEFT AbsensiCepat (ac-type has all 7 options, ac-rfid-input submits on Enter and shows ac-result inline, ac-class dropdown + ac-contact-wali with valid https://wa.me/62... href) and RIGHT MifjanOke login (login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button). Admin/guru/siswa login all succeed and redirect properly. /kiosk has kiosk-type-select (7 options), kiosk-rfid-input, kiosk-capture-btn, kiosk-upload-btn, kiosk-berhalangan-class, kiosk-contact-wali (valid wa.me link). /absensi 'jenis' filter shows all 7 options; Rekap/Harian/Manual tabs present.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_attendance.KioskScanInput default type='kehadiran' is stale (no longer in ATTENDANCE_TYPES); if a client omits 'type', request will 400. Change default to 'datang' to match new type set.
routes_attendance.ManualAttendanceInput.type default is also 'kehadiran' (stale) - same issue for manual attendance clients that omit type.

attendance_recap counts['hadir'] uses .get with fallback but if attendance record has unexpected status, KeyError could be raised via counts[status] then counts.get; the current code does counts[r.get('status','hadir')] = counts.get(...)+1 which will KeyError on assignment for unknown statuses. Use setdefault or normalize.
